threads.body: In the `tool_call_response` example, the `id` value has a leading whitespace (`" call_..."`), while the preceding `tool_call` part uses `"call_..."` without whitespace. This makes the example internally inconsistent and could mislead implementors trying to match request/response IDs.

replies.body: Good catch — fixed in `8be786b`. Dropped the stray leading space so the `tool_call_response` `id` matches the request's `tool_call` id, and regenerated the docs from the source.
